column1: # Why measures: the deck steps a 47 ns lossy-line ladder at tmax=0.1 ns
# and the reference's ringing tails are not grid-stable. Refining
# ngspice's own step 10x moves its half-swing crossings by up to 158 ps
# (v(5) rise) and its windowed means by up to 17 mV (v(4) over
# [28n,40n]); the pointwise gate fails on v(6) tail samples that differ
# by 0.8 mV on a 6.4 V node. RSpice's crossings sit within 20 ps of the
# reference and every mean within 2 mV, inside that self-movement.
# Source: VS PULSE 0->5 V at 15.9 ns, 5->0 V at 31.9 ns (0.2 ns edges).
# v(2), v(3) = driven ends; v(4), v(5) = far ends; v(6) = source-side
# node with the largest overshoot (6.38 V) and undershoot (-1.28 V).
# Tolerances are twice the larger of the reference's refinement movement
